svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 40 mm off 25 x 10 mm flat bar; square and deburr the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bar stands on a 40 x 10 mm face (the bottom), 25 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom: drill 2.5 mm, 9 mm deep, and tap M3 8 deep, 12 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre, on the centre line. Screws come up through the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back face (the 40 x 25 face toward the back of the case): drill

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2.5 mm, 7 deep, and tap M3 6 deep, 10 mm each side of centre and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 18 mm up from the bottom. One MOSFET tab is screwed to each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the back face flat; no burrs may pierce the insulating pad.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each MOSFET tab on an insulating thermal pad, with an insulating

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bushing under the screw head. The tabs are live at PV voltage.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the MOSFETs fitted, a meter reads open circuit from each
